input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Come into My Life"?

documents.text: Come into My Life (Gala album) Come into My Life is the debut studio album by Italian dance music singer Gala, released in November 1997. The album was recorded at the Planet Studio in Milan, Italy. Four singles were released: "Come into My Life", "Freed from Desire", "Suddenly" and "Let a Boy Cry". The UK channel 4 teletext page 'Planet Sound' gave the album 3 out of 5, praising Gala for the "surprising variety".
